seoTitle: Yellowstone Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Yellowstone test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're John, Beth, Rip, Kayce, Jamie, Monica, Jimmy or Teeter — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the patriarch, the firecracker, or the loyal right-hand man? Answer 11 everyday questions about family, loyalty and hard work, and find out which Yellowstone character you are.

characters.name: John Dutton
characters.title: The Patriarch
characters.summary: Proud, stubborn and fiercely protective. You'll fight for what your family built, whatever it costs.
description: Like John, you'll protect what's yours. He's the widowed patriarch of the Dutton family, and he runs the huge Yellowstone ranch in Montana.
You never stop fighting. John faces constant attacks from people who want his family's land.
You step up when you're needed. John becomes governor of Montana.
characters.flaw: You're so stubborn that you'd rather lose everything than give an inch.
characters.signature: A cowboy hat, a hard stare and land you'll never sell.
characters.clashReason: they'd decide what's best for you without asking

characters.name: Beth Dutton
characters.title: The Firecracker
characters.summary: Brilliant, fearless and savage when crossed. You love hard, and you never back down.
description: Like Beth, you're brilliant and fearless. She's John's only daughter, and a highly intelligent financier.
You know how to get what you want. Beth is a master manipulator, with a tongue sharp enough to cut.
You love hard. Beth's on-and-off relationship with Rip starts when they're teenagers, and they eventually marry.
characters.flaw: You'd rather burn a bridge than admit you were wrong.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a sharper tongue and a plan to ruin somebody's day.
characters.clashReason: they'd tear you apart with one sentence, and enjoy it

characters.name: Rip Wheeler
characters.title: The Loyal One
characters.summary: Tough, quiet and loyal to the end. You don't say much, but you'd do anything for your people.
description: Like Rip, you're loyal to the end. He's the ranch foreman, and John's right-hand man.
You found your family. The Duttons took Rip in when he was a young runaway, and he's devoted to them ever since.
You've got a softer side. Rip has loved Beth since they were teenagers, and they eventually marry and start a new life on another ranch.
characters.flaw: You keep everything inside until it boils over.
characters.signature: A worn hat, a quiet nod and a job you'll finish no matter what.
characters.clashReason: they'd go silent and stare at you until you backed down

characters.name: Kayce Dutton
characters.title: The One in the Middle
characters.summary: Steady, skilled and always torn between two worlds. You try to do right by everyone, and it isn't easy.
description: Like Kayce, you're torn between two worlds. He's John's youngest son, and a former Navy SEAL.
Your own family comes first. Kayce lives on the Broken Rock reservation with his wife, Monica, and their son, before moving back to the ranch.
You make the hard call. When Kayce inherits the ranch, he can't afford the taxes, so he sells it to the Broken Rock reservation and keeps a small piece of land for himself.
characters.flaw: You try so hard to please everyone that you end up pulled in two.
characters.signature: A steady hand, a quiet voice and a family you'd do anything for.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to pick a side when you needed them to

characters.name: Jamie Dutton
characters.title: The Outsider
characters.summary: Smart, ambitious and desperate to belong. You want to prove yourself, and you'll take your own road to do it.
description: Like Jamie, you want to belong. He's John's adopted son, and an ambitious politician.
You climb high. Jamie becomes Montana's attorney general.
You go your own way. Jamie was once completely loyal to his father, but the way the family treats him drives him to follow his own path.
characters.flaw: You want approval so badly that you'll betray the people who won't give it.
characters.signature: A perfect tie, a five-year plan and a chip on your shoulder.
characters.clashReason: they'd agree with you to your face, then go behind your back

characters.name: Monica Dutton
characters.title: The Conscience
characters.summary: Grounded, principled and nobody's pushover. You stand up for what's right, even when it's hard.
description: Like Monica, you're grounded and principled. She's Kayce's wife, and she starts out as a teacher on the Broken Rock reservation.
You keep growing. Monica later becomes a professor at Montana State University.
You hold your own. Monica marries into the Duttons, one of the toughest families in Montana.
characters.flaw: You hold everyone to a standard most people can't meet.
characters.signature: A stack of papers to grade, a steady gaze and a hard truth.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you, calmly, exactly why you're in the wrong

characters.name: Jimmy Hurdstrom
characters.title: The Lovable Underdog
characters.summary: Clumsy, kind and still figuring things out. You mess up a lot, but you keep getting back on the horse.
description: Like Jimmy, you're still figuring things out. He's a Yellowstone ranch hand and an amateur bronc rider.
You take your chances. Jimmy leaves Yellowstone to work at the famous 6666 Ranch in Texas.
Love changes you. At the 6666, Jimmy falls for Emily, the ranch's chief vet technician, and they get engaged.
characters.flaw: You get into trouble without even trying.
characters.signature: A dusty hat, a few bruises and a big heart.
characters.clashReason: they'd drag you into a mess that wasn't your fault

characters.name: Teeter
characters.title: The Wild One
characters.summary: Loud, foul-mouthed and loyal to the bone. You say what you think, and you work as hard as anyone.
description: Like Teeter, you're loud and proud. She's a tough-talking ranch hand from Texas, hired on at Yellowstone.
You earn your place. Teeter is given the ranch's brand, which ties her to Yellowstone for good.
You fall hard. Teeter falls for her fellow ranch hand Colby.
characters.flaw: You'd rather swear at a problem than talk about it.
characters.signature: A filthy mouth, a loud laugh and a hard day's work.
characters.clashReason: they'd say something so outrageous you wouldn't know where to look

questions.text: Someone threatens something your family built. You...

options.text: Fight for it with everything you've got, and never give an inch
Find the weak spot in their plan, and take it apart
Do whatever needs doing, and don't ask questions
Look for a way through that doesn't make things worse

questions.text: The weekend is yours, with no plans at all. You...

options.text: Spend it at a rodeo, or on the back of a horse
Head into town, and see what trouble you can find
Go somewhere quiet with the person you love, and say very little
Volunteer at something in your community

questions.text: A family member makes a decision you hate. You...

options.text: Tell them, cruelly and accurately, exactly what you think
Go along with it, and quietly resent it for years
Remind them who's in charge
Speak up calmly, even if nobody wants to hear it

questions.text: You start a new job, and everyone tests you. You...

options.text: Work twice as hard, and talk twice as loud
Mess up, laugh it off and keep going until you earn their respect
Keep quiet, and let your work prove it
Learn every rule, and follow it perfectly

questions.text: Someone close to you is in real trouble. You...

options.text: Drop everything and go, no questions asked
Get them safe, then make sure it never happens again
Get there first, and take charge of everything
Panic, then show up anyway

questions.text: You're offered a promotion that means moving away from home. You...

options.text: Take it. It's your chance to prove yourself
Turn it down. Home is everything
Go, but promise yourself you'll come back
Talk it over properly with your partner first

questions.text: Someone is rude to your friend in public. You...

options.text: Get in their face, and swear a lot
Step in, calm and quietly dangerous
Say something so cutting they leave
Calmly get your friend out of there before it gets worse

questions.text: You mess up badly on the job. You...

options.text: Own it, and work until it's fixed
Hide it, and hope nobody finds out
Fix it before anyone notices, then brag about it
Admit it, and hope they'll give you another chance

questions.text: Someone asks about your plans for the future. You...

options.text: Talk about keeping what your family built for the next generation
Shrug. Tomorrow is tomorrow's problem
Describe your five-year plan, in detail
Talk about making things a little fairer for everyone

questions.text: You own a huge ranch, and developers want to buy it. You...

options.text: Never sell. Not one acre
Fight dirty, and make them regret ever asking
Back the boss, and protect him while he fights
Think about what's best for your kids' future

questions.text: You've joined a powerful ranching family with a lot of enemies. You...

options.text: Stay true to who you are, and don't let them change you
Try to earn their respect, any way you can
Keep your head down, and work hard
Mouth off, and make sure they know you're not scared
